mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate weakening labor market strength.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain negative despite UNRATE crossing above 4.5% in a period of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0).

mechanism_narrative: A surge in demand (GDPC1) accompanied by a contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) signals potential inflationary pressures, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when GDPC1 exceeds its 4-month prior value and INDPRO falls below its 1-month prior value.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate amplifies positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced policy tightness.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regime, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite a sustained FEDFUNDS decline.

mechanism_narrative: Continuously rising employment numbers (PAYEMS) signal robust labor market conditions, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite sustained upward trend in PAYEMS.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending (GDPC1) over the past quarter predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as market anticipates continued economic growth.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite a sustained upward trend in GDPC1.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) alongside rising federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) creates supply-demand imbalances, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when both INDPRO falls below its 1-month prior and FEDFUNDS rises above its 1-month prior.

mechanism_narrative: In a period of financial stress, a decline in the federal funds rate below 3.5% intensifies risk-off sentiment, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during financial stress periods despite FEDFUNDS falling below 3.5%.
